data.spec: Implement six additive deterministic capabilities on main0740237 in isolated worktree /Users/noahsyrdal/foundershub-facility-operations (NLS/facility-operations). New config/facility-operations.json owns climate, repeat-fault, readiness and refill policies. Climate module accepts only already-validated FacilityReading, returns derived readings (temperature_drop_c and condensation_margin_c) and exposes assessments; add surface_temperature_c input. No surface measurement => unconfirmed condensation assessment. Existing FacilityEngine thresholds/actions handle derived rules. FacilityOperations attaches to FacilityService; persists incident-work links, distinct repeat-fault episodes, daily readiness reports, refill checks. Reuses WorkService/WorkScheduler, local notifications only. GET /api/facility/operations exposes {policy,climate,readiness,refill_checks,incident_work}; no new supplier executor. WorkCreate gains optional followup:{interval_minutes:1..10080,max_reminders:0..10}; existing default remains24h/2. Root owns operations/service integration/contracts/docs; bounded agents own climate module+tests and work followup model/scheduler+tests. No hardware/serial/runtime changes.
